svg.title: Bowfin: safe to checked to verified
svg.desc: One language. Three assurance levels. Increase assurance where the consequences justify it. Safe: ownership + memory safety; language-enforced foundation. Checked: contracts enforced; runtime assurance where useful. Verified: declared properties proven; static proof under assumptions. Same language. Escalating assurance. No second dialect.

path.aria-label: Increase assurance where the consequences justify it.
SAME LANGUAGE • ESCALATING ASSURANCE • NO SECOND DIALECT
